name_input: UNIVERSAL CORPORATION LIMITED,; M/S ARIHANT FASHION WORLD; Universal Corporation Ltd; UNIVERSAL CORPORATION LTD ; UNIVERSAL CORPORATION LTD.; UNIVERSAL CORPORATION LIMITED

Shekou, CHINA -> CHENNAI SEA INMAA1, India 39269099 7732377". No outbound (India-origin) shipment row was seen for this entity. Source counter: page claims 'Total Shipments 5144 / Trading Partners 145 / Ports 48'; rows actually rendered = 5, all imports.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: screener.in slugs 'UNIVCORP' and 'UNIVERSAL' both returned HTTP 404, and volza/eximpedia/trademo returned HTTP 403. No domestic supply record was seen.
note: CRITICAL DISAMBIGUATION: the two other ImportKey slugs are a DIFFERENT legal entity, not this Indian company. Slug 'universal-corporation-ltd' (337 records) and slug 'universal-corporation' (16 records) both resolve to a Kenya-based pharma distributor at Mombasa/Nairobi, e.g. "2026-02-26 LOTUS TECHNICALS PRIVATE LIMITED -> UNIVERSAL CORPORATION LTD. HEPA Filter ... NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India -> Mombasa, Kenya 84219900 1030216" and "2026-02-17 JRS PHARMA GUJARAT MICROWAX PRIVATE LIMITED -> UNIVERSAL CORPORATION Nairobi, Kenya 29420090 9741867". Those are exports BY Indian suppliers TO a Kenyan buyer named Universal Corporation; they must NOT be credited to the Indian Patparganj entity. The Indian entity (Plot No.234, FIE, Patparganj Industrial Area, Delhi) is evidenced only as an IMPORTER of Chinese houseware/appliances under brands AGARO and LUVLAP (HS 39269099, 90191020, 76151030, 82142090) - i.e. it is a domestic-market distributor/importer, not an exporter. Declared HS codes (392490; 871500; 940180; 961900) do not match any observed record; per Rule 3 this is not a rejection ground - actual observed codes are 39269099/90191020/76151030/82142090 and should be corrected. Role: trader/importer-distributor (not manufacturer). 'M/S ARIHANT FASHION WORLD' appears to be a separate/unrelated name in the batch and no shipment record linking it to Universal Corporation was found. Export: no traces of outbound shipments found. Domestic: no public evidence retrieved (sources blocked/404), so unknown rather than confirmed. Revenue and export volume: null - not public in accessible sources.
